panels.rationale: Single endoscopic ultrasound image captioned as gastric glomangioma with in-text description of well-circumscribed iso-hypoechoic submucosal mass, consistent with glomuvenous malformation (glomangioma) ultrasound manifestation.
panels.attribution_text: Yugruk et al. A Rare Case of Gastric Glomangioma Mimicking a Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST).. Cureus 2025. doi:10.7759/cureus.98666. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 2.
panels.figure_caption: Endoscopic ultrasonography view of gastric glomangioma.
in_text_mentions: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy demonstrated a 2 cm subepithelial lesion at the incisura angularis with intact overlying mucosa (Figure 1). Endoscopic ultrasonography revealed a well-circumscribed, iso-hypoechoic mass (19.5×11.3 mm) confined to the submucosa without invasion of the muscularis propria, with minimal cystic changes and poor vascularity (Figure 2). Abdominal computed tomography showed no evidence of metastatic disease.
